title: Pac-Man Fruit
description: replaces golden carrots with the bonus fruit found in Pac-Man.
body:
Replaces golden carrots with the bonus fruit found in Pac-Man. The replacements goes as follows:

64-57: Cherry
56-49: Strawberry
48-41: Orange
40-33: Apple
32-25: Melon
24-17: Galaxian
16-9: Bell
8-2: Key
1: Crown

![All the fruit.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6242fcfd22e04bc3c76686b09da51fe4cb0337b1.png)

Tested on 1.21.4 and 1.21.10, but it should work for 1.21.4 to 1.21.11.
